description: Bills before the University Senate (senate.umd.edu): the current academic year's legislation with where each bill stands and who is reviewing it, or the archive of past bills back to 2001. Filter by words in the title or document number. Call senate_get_bill for a bill's history and documents. No login needed.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-200 (default 50)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

query.description: Only bills whose title or document number contains this text

scope.description: "current" for this year's bills (default), "archived" for past years

name: senate_list_legislation

document_number.description: Senate document number, e.g. "26-27-04": the academic year and a sequence number

is_active.description: Whether the bill is still moving through the process

status.description: Where the bill is in its life

under_review_by.description: Committee, council or office currently reviewing the bill; null once it has moved on

years.description: Calendar years the bill was active in

title: List legislation
